post.content:
A 19-year-old genius builds a flying suit in her dorm, gets kicked out of MIT, joins a crew of criminals led by a guy in a magic hoodie, turns her dead best friend into a sassy hologram, and then gets offered a deal by the devil. Who orders pizza. 🍕😈

This is Ironheart Season 1, DUMBED DOWN: the whole story explained, every twist, the villains, the ending and the post-credits scene. Plus way too many cartoon cutaway gags.

New to Marvel? Perfect. You don't need to have watched anything to follow this.
